review: "Go Feed the Poor." No metaphor, no build, no altar call. An instruction. I have that hall on Fridays because somebody once gave me an instruction and not a feeling. Five stars, and I would like to say one more thing while I am here. On the second Friday the free plan cut the music at song eight with the room full. I could not restart it. Forty kids watched me fail to make a speaker work. The plan is three ninety-five which is twenty-two reais, and that is not the same three ninety-five you are thinking of. I am not asking for charity. I am telling you the wall is in the middle of the room, not at the end of it.
